title: Manipur SSC Recruitment 2026 – Special Primary Teacher Posts
shortInfo: Manipur SSC has announced notification for Special Primary Teacher posts. Required qualification: 10+2, D.Ed. in Special Education, TET-1. Last date to apply: 20-08-26.
howToApply: Register on the portal (https://manipurssc.mn.gov.in) using parameters matching your Employment Exchange sponsorship credentials, then log in using your User ID and password.
Fill Application Details: Enter your Profile parameters accurately (Name, DOB, Category, Language, RCI CRR status, and Government Service NOC if applicable).
Upload Media (photo, scanned documents, signature) and accept the mandatory qualification validation declaration checkbox.
Pay the application fee via UPI/Net Banking/Cards: General & OBC: Rs. 400/-; SC & ST: Rs. 200/-; PwD: Exempted.
Confirm details, complete form submission, and generate acknowledgement receipt.
Note: Only candidates sponsored by the concerned employment exchange shall be allowed to submit applications online.

title: PNB Recruitment 2026 – Local Bank Officer (LBO) (Last Date Extended) Posts
shortInfo: PNB has announced notification for Local Bank Officer (LBO) (Last Date Extended) posts. Required qualification: Graduate in any discipline. Last date to apply: 16-08-26.

dates.event: Closing Date of Online Registration (Extended Upto)
Tentative Date of Online Test (August 2026/ September 2026)

howToApply: Visit the Bank’s official website https://pnb.bank.in/ under Recruitment/Career section.
Click on the link ‘CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION’ to register your application by entering basic information.
Note down the provisional registration number and password generated by the system.
Fill in the online application form carefully with all required details.

Scan and upload photograph, signature, left hand thumb impression, handwritten declaration, proof of age, caste/disability certificate, educational qualification, and work experience documents as per specified guidelines.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI.
Submit the application form after verifying all details.
Take a printout of the e-receipt and online application form for future reference.
Applications can be submitted from 20.07.2026 to 09.08.2026 only.
